_doc: Experiment grids read by src/afp/experiments.py (python -m afp.experiments <name>). Each run also writes its full parameters to results/raw/runs/<run_id>/config.json and run_record.json. Tiers T100 and T1K use the real candidates; T10K replays the 1,000 T1K candidates 10 times under new task ids (trace replay, no model call).

matrix._doc: 3 tiers x 3 configurations x 3 repeats; wall timeout of the week-2 design

scaling._doc: Lean worker curve on 10,000 tasks; 30 s wall timeout so heartbeats (400k) stay the primary limit

batch_sweep._doc: verification batch size at a fixed worker count; b1_idx = batch 1 with the indexed queue

baseline._doc: required baseline: zero-shot, one problem per request, one candidate, one Lean worker, no repair

retry._doc: same worker kill as fault; max_attempts 1 = no re-delivery (expired lease -> dead-letter)

release._doc: ablation of release_on_restart (hand the rest of a batch back before a REPL restart)

repro._doc: matrix cell T1K/A again on the machine of 26/10
